items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Blockchain is ‘perfect solution’ for AI agent trust, VeChain CEO says
items.content: Sunny Lu said AI agents would need identity and reputation systems, making the case while promoting agent-building platform VeWorld.ai.

items.title: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?
items.content: Decentralized AI networks want to turn everyday phones into an alternative to centralized computing infrastructure  — but skeptics have their doubts.

items.title: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says
items.content: The SkyBridge founder said disputes over ethics restrictions also stalled negotiations, with both sides responsible for the setback.

items.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
items.content: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.

items.title: Bitcoin win rate vs. S&P 500 recovers as post-midterm history favors stocks
items.content: Bitcoin outperformed the S&P 500 in half of the past 90 US trading sessions, while historical midterm data highlights gains for stocks.

items.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
items.content: South Korea is seeking a fourth delay to its 22% crypto tax, months after reaffirming plans to begin taxing digital asset gains in January 2027.

items.title: France budget rejection sidelines stablecoin tax, wallet reporting
items.content: Three adopted amendments, including stablecoin taxation and self-custody reporting, fall away but could be reintroduced in the Senate.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs draw $128M as crypto rebounds after midterms
items.content: Fidelity led Bitcoin ETF inflows, while BlackRock’s IBIT shed another $201 million, extending its outflow streak to four trading sessions.

items.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack, assesses losses
items.content: The bank said customer funds were unaffected after attackers accessed its systems through a service provider’s platform.

items.title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
items.content: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

items.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
items.content: Democrats wasted little time after their midterm victory, warning tech CEOs to prepare for subpoenas and signaling fresh investigations into Trump’s business dealings.

items.title: India warns AI-powered hackers targeting crypto exchanges at ‘machine speed’
items.content: India’s cybersecurity agency says a threat actor is escalating an AI-assisted hacking campaign targeting crypto exchanges and other financial firms.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin says phased reopening to begin Monday, will cover losses
items.content: Customers will initially be able to view their holdings, while withdrawals and trading remain suspended pending security checks.

items.title: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
items.content: The crypto exchange’s founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.

items.title: Crypto PACs eye 2028 ‘new map’ as Democrats take Congress
items.content: Crypto super PACs spent more than $176 million on the midterms, but the Democratic sweep raises the prospect of tougher industry scrutiny.

items.title: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike
items.content: From setting up an SMSF or a company, to just leaving the country entirely, here are some strategies Australian Bitcoiners can employ to deal with 2027’s massive CGT hike.

items.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
items.content: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.

items.title: Riot shares surge on $28B AI lease as Hut 8 sinks on revenue miss
items.content: Bitcoin miner Riot sold BTC to finance its AI expansion, while Hut 8 reported falling revenue and rising costs before its major data center leases generate income.

items.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
items.content: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.

items.title: Bitcoin hits $80.5K as US stocks rally on midterm election results
items.content: Bitcoin climbed toward $80,500 as risk assets rallied on Democrats’ midterm election gains and oil prices fell.

items.title: France backs reporting for self-custodied crypto worth 100K euros or more
items.content: The amendment would require taxpayers to report holdings worth at least $112,000, but the measure still needs to survive the budget process.

items.title: Canton’s CC rises 4% as SEC staff view it as ‘digital commodity’
items.content: SEC staff’s no-action letter covers CC earned by running infrastructure and applications, but is not a binding ruling on its legal status.

items.title: Binance hack may be ‘temporary setback’ for crypto, Grayscale’s Pandl says
items.content: Zach Pandl highlighted institutional custody safeguards as crypto markets recovered some losses following the record $6.3 billion Binance hack.

items.title: Justin Sun seeks $264K sanctions over World Liberty’s UAE disclosure
items.content: Sun plans to refile his token-freeze lawsuit in California state court after the sanctions motion is resolved. A hearing is set for Dec. 10.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.16B as Bitwise calls selling ‘short-term’
items.content: Bitwise’s André Dragosch attributed Bitcoin ETF outflows to weaker market sentiment, saying institutions have largely maintained their exposure.

items.title: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress
items.content: Democrats won control of Congress in the 2026 US midterms. Catch up on key races, crypto-backed candidates and the outlook for crypto regulation.

items.title: Binance hackers move 81% of stolen Solana, route funds via THORChain
items.content: The Binance attackers moved most of the stolen SOL and continued laundering funds through THORChain after the protocol resumed swaps.

items.title: Democrats win US House to secure control of Congress in midterms
items.content: Democrats will take control of House committees in January 2027, giving them power to investigate President Donald Trump’s administration.

items.title: Bitcoin bounces from 7-week low under $76K as Democrats sweep Congress
items.content: Bitcoin price downside reached a seven-week-low of $75,618 as 24-hour crypto long liquidations neared $300 million.
